info.longName: FolioBeyond Alternative Income and Interest Rate Hedge ETF

funds_data.description: The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to generate attractive current income while providing protection against rising interest rates (i.e., an interest rate hedge). The fund invests primarily in interest-only mortgage-backed securities (“MBS IOs”) and U.S. Treasury bonds. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in income producing fixed income securities exhibiting alternative income characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
